description: A Django adapter that brings WebMCP to Insight UI sites, exposing public content, navigation and reviewed actions as explicit tools while the application keeps control of content, permissions and execution.
rules: Add insight_ui_webmcp to INSTALLED_APPS and load the webmcp_assets template tag once in the site shell.
Prepare and validate the host manifest with the webmcp_prepare and webmcp_validate management commands before enabling WebMCP on a site.
Use explicit host profiles to bind the shared manifest to the site's own content and handlers; this adapter uses the installed ais-webmcp core instead of shipping its own register.js.
